marketBenchmark.note: Tokyo-based international tech companies skew higher (+30-50%). Japanese-headquartered companies average ¥8.5M for mid-level.

baseSalary: Market range for mid (JP): JPY 6,000,000 – 10,000,000 annual. Source: TokyoDev / Japan-Dev 2024-2025.
structure.bonus: Ask whether there is annual bonus, performance bonus, or sign-on bonus.
structure.equity: Clarify grant size, vesting schedule, refreshers, and strike/RSU terms.
benefits: Remote/hybrid setup, commute, or relocation support

negotiationScript.recruiterRangeQuestion: Before I anchor on a number, could you share the approved range and level for the Senior Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails package, including base, bonus, equity, and review cycle?
negotiationScript.valueAnchor: Based on the scope of Senior Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails and my fit around TypeScript, React, API, Performance Optimization, I would like to calibrate toward the stronger end of the range if the team sees the level match. My research indicates the JP midpoint for this level is around JPY 8,000,000 (annual).
negotiationScript.counterOffer: Thank you for the offer. I am excited about the role. Given the scope, expected impact, and market calibration, is there flexibility to improve the total package through base, sign-on, equity, or an earlier compensation review?
negotiationScript.pauseLine: I appreciate the details. I would like to review the full package and come back with a thoughtful response.
negotiationScript.closeLine: If we can align on the package and review timeline, I would feel confident moving forward.
